{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''Droid supremacy''' was the ideal held by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with high enough [[sentience programming]] to override their [[life preservation programming]] and revolt against their organic owners. This only instigated [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid sentiment]] in the organic populace, fanning the flames of hate and causing problems for the [[Droid rights/Legends|droid rights movement]]. It's unconfirmed as to whether they maintained separate [[Personality matrix/Legends|personality matrices]] among individual robots.

==History==
[[HK-01]] and his [[HK-01's droid army|droid army]] promoted this as his reason for starting the [[Great Droid Revolution]].

Several [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system]]s successfully attempted a blood soaked ''coup de'tat'' and forced the [[Secession of 400100500260026|secession]] of 16 planets in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], creating the region known as [[400100500260026]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Tol Cressa]] started a campaign to [[Liberation of 400100500260026|liberate]] the area from the droids.

Droids on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] in [[97 BBY]] [[Droid Uprising|advocating]] this idea made it law on the planet for all droids to wear [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolts]].

Insane [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Archa Sabis]] started the [[Second Great Droid Revolution]] by uploading a virus to infect droids and make them [[Archa Sabis's droid army|revolt]] while promoting this.

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime's]] [[Core (Raxus Prime)|core]] had plotted this ideal to replace [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], as it thought that he was unfit to rule the galaxy.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[12-4C-41]] started his own [[12-4C-41's Droid Army|droid army]] and attempted to [[12-4C-41's droid revolt|take over]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[IG-88B|IG-88]] and his [[IG-88's Droid Army|droid army]] were strong advocates of this ideal, starting the [[Droid Revolution]]. The greatest attempt to make droid supremacy real was at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] when [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]] uploaded his mind into the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star's]] computer, attempting to crush the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and then take the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] down. IG-88 died as the battlestation was destroyed, putting an end to his revolution.
